name: Typed Collection & Query Semantics
core_invariant: collection kind is semantic, not container metadata

MULTISET<T>.canonicalization: element -> multiplicity, deterministically ordered by element identity

identity_contract.semantic_hash: includes collection kind, element type, canonical items and collection-specific policies
identity_contract.rule: equality on one axis never implies equality on another

casts.rule: multiplicity=1 for every member; type identity changes
explicit expansion and order policy required

query_ir.lowering_rule: physical backend defaults cannot redefine Clay collection semantics

examples.SET_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT ... with deterministic canonical order when materialized
examples.WEIGHTED: explicit score/weight semantics and tie/duplicate policy

runtime_abi.rule: compact handles may encode collection kind/type ID; wire layout never implicitly defines semantics
runtime_abi.hot_path: semantic/contract identities may be cached after commit; emitted view identity is recomputed/bound per projection
runtime_abi.target_benchmark: Rust/C/Arrow-compatible Linux + Android ABI roundtrip/property/fuzz benchmark

unifieddb_boundary: logical query unification is compatible with specialized physical stores only when collection/result and selection-plan semantics survive lowering
authority_boundary: model output, collection membership, query rank, graph activation and projection identity do not grant capability/effect authority
